thread:
anya: Quick recap from today's mini-run on pricing UX. Ran three micro-variants: baseline, benefits-led, and calculator-forward. Wanted to surface learnings and proposed next steps.

matt: go on.

anya: headline: calculator-forward wins for conversion intent (calc -> demo click) +9% vs baseline. benefits-led gets more dwell but fewer calc starts. sample ~2.6k sessions across paid + organic.

elaine: numbers: calc-forward CTR to demo 9.3% (p=0.04), baseline 8.5%, benefits-led 7.1%. However, benefits-led reduced chat opens by 14%.

sam: heatmap shows calc-forward pushes eyeballs to the right-hand calculator panel and the microcopy "Estimate monthly cost" seems to be sticky.

cj: routing question: currently any demo click routes to sales-pricing. I'd propose demo clicks tagged with "calc_estimate" be routed to growth-ops first unless enterprise signals present. Thoughts?

matt: makes sense to triage by enterprise signals. What's the signal set?

anya: proposed signals: company_size >= 500, requested_feature_tags includes "sso|onprem|compliance", or manual selection "enterprise" in calc. If any true -> sales-pricing. Else growth-ops.

ops-bot: current routing rules last updated 1829900000. Rules: demo_click -> sales-pricing@redwood.com; calc_lead -> growth-ops@redwood.com.

cj: I'll coordinate with ops to add the new enterprise signal check. cc: legal if we touch feature tag data.

elaine: quick UX note: we tested moving a short FAQ above the fold vs collapsing it under "Need help?". Putting it above reduced tier-related support searches by 10% in the 48h window. Small sample but repeatable.

sam: suggestion: combine calc-forward layout with an always-visible 3-question FAQ pill above the calculator. Keeps calc prominence but answers quick doubts.

anya: agreed. Also want to test a tiny friction field in the calculator: "expected monthly tokens" required vs optional. We saw fewer low-quality leads when required in a prior test. Proposal: make it required for the experiment and show a tooltip: "Estimated tokens helps match the right tier."

matt: if required increases abandon rate by >7% rollback.

anya: action items: 1) Make calc-forward variant the default for the next 10k sessions, 2) Add FAQ pill above calculator, 3) Make monthly_tokens required in experiment variant, 4) Update routing to triage demo clicks with enterprise signals to sales-pricing, otherwise growth-ops, 5) Elaine to report conversion + support metrics at day 3 and day 7.

cj: I'll file the ops ticket now and ping AE leads.

sam: prototype & copy at https://redwood/marketing/ux/price-calc-forward-v3 (screenshots + copy deck).

ops-bot: ops ticket created: OPS-4123. Scheduled deploy window: 1835600000-1835603600.

anya: cool. one more microcopy tweak idea: change CTA from "See estimate" -> "Estimate my monthly cost" for more personal phrasing. small A/B in the run.

elaine: noted. Tracking plan update needed for new event names: calc_started_v3, calc_submit_v3. i'll push that.

matt: ok set. reconvene Fri 9am to review early signals.

anya: thanks team :rocket:
